TREATMENT OF PHARYNGITIS (SORE THROAT)
Treatment Goals
- Control symptoms by identifying and treating primary causes
Non-drug Treatment
- Treat sinusitis
- Surgery for obstructive nasal conditions
- Treat dental caries
Drug Treatment
- Appropriate antibacterial agent if indicated
Supportive Measures
- Reduction or avoidance of exposure to known irritants-tobacco, alcohol,
etc
